desc: Implement and validate LCS-row transition: reconstruct old row from an increment mask and compute the new row left-to-right using the LCS recurrence.
Build/precompute weighted transitions for all \(2^N\) masks, aggregating letters with identical effects.
Run length-\(M\) modular DP from the zero mask and aggregate final counts by mask popcount.
Provide Python stdin/stdout code and verify it against the stated samples.
